en.compliance.ladder_outcome_pending: Outcome: pending — tick the chips of steps 1 and 3 to declare.
en.compliance.ladder_outcome_prohibited: Outcome: prohibited practice (Art. 5) — this may not run.
en.compliance.ladder_outcome_transparency: Outcome: the AI Act applies — Art. 4 (literacy) and Art. 50 (transparency). Not high-risk.

nl.compliance.ladder_outcome_prohibited: Uitkomst: verboden praktijk (Art. 5) — dit mag niet draaien.
nl.compliance.ladder_outcome_transparency: Uitkomst: de AI Act geldt — Art. 4 (geletterdheid) en Art. 50 (transparantie). Niet hoog-risico.
